character: Brands Hatch Indy — the 1.9km short circuit. Paddock Hill down to Druids and back via Graham Hill, then Surtees onto the Cooper Straight and the long Clearways/Clark sweep to start-finish. Same dramatic elevation and blind crests as the GP layout, but a punishingly short lap where a single missed apex is a large fraction of your time.

corners.name: Paddock Hill Bend
corners.technique: Brake after the 'two' board while slightly turning in. Blind apex — the corner drops away steeply. Late apex, let car drift to exit
corners.trap: Braking too late into the blind downhill; understeer into the gravel

corners.name: Druids
corners.technique: Hard braking uphill, 1st or 2nd gear. Late apex, progressive throttle on exit
corners.trap: Locking fronts on the uphill approach; early apex kills exit speed down Graham Hill

corners.name: Graham Hill Bend
corners.technique: Brake before outside kerbing starts, 2nd gear, mid-point apex. Don't cut inside kerb (causes TC/spin)
corners.trap: Too much inside kerb causes instability on the bumpy downhill

corners.name: Surtees
corners.technique: Tricky off-camber corner — brake at the 'one' board, trail brake in. On Indy this exit feeds the Cooper Straight and the long Clearways, so a clean rotation is worth the whole lap
corners.trap: Off-camber catches out — understeer on entry is common; need good car rotation

corners.name: Clearways
corners.technique: The Indy circuit's defining corner. Long constant-radius right — get the car settled, take a patient apex and unwind early so you can be full throttle before the pit straight. Exit speed here sets your whole lap
corners.trap: Greedy early apex forces a lift; running wide on exit bleeds speed all the way down the start-finish straight
